## 描述 (Description)

请简要描述此 PR 的目的以及它解决的问题。(Please briefly describe the purpose of this PR and the issue it solves.)
Fixes # (issue number)

## 更改类型 (Type of change)

请删除不相关的选项。(Please delete options that are not relevant.)

- [ ] Bug 修复 (Bug fix - non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] 新功能 (New feature - non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 破坏性更改 (Breaking change - fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 文档更新 (This change requires a documentation update)

## 测试方法 (How Has This Been Tested?)

请描述你用来验证更改的测试。提供说明以便我们重现。 (Please describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes. Provide instructions so we can reproduce.)

- [ ] 单元测试 (Unit Tests)
- [ ] UI 测试 / 仪器化测试 (UI / Instrumented Tests)
- [ ] 人工测试 (Manual Verification)

## 检查清单 (Checklist):

- [ ] 我的代码遵循本项目的架构规范 (My code follows the architecture guidelines of this project)
- [ ] 我已经对我的代码进行了自我审查 (I have performed a self-review of my own code)
- [ ] 我已经相应地更新了文档 (I have made corresponding changes to the documentation)
- [ ] 我添加了证明我的修复有效或我的功能正常的测试 (I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works)
- [ ] 新的和现有的自动化测试都在本地通过了 (New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes)
